content.source_page_summary: List of clinical trial/study/registry acronyms and their expansions related to acute coronary syndromes and myocardial infarction.

acronyms.description: Acute myocardial infarction with ST-segment elevation.

acronyms.expansion: ShorT and OPtimal Duration of Dual AntiPlatelet Therapy-2 Study for the Patients With ACS
acronyms.description: Study evaluating optimal duration of dual antiplatelet therapy in acute coronary syndrome patients.

acronyms.expansion: Strategic Reperfusion Early After Myocardial Infarction
acronyms.description: Study focused on early reperfusion strategies after myocardial infarction.

acronyms.expansion: Swedish Web-System for Enhancement and Development of Evidence-Based Care in Heart Disease Evaluated According to Recommended Therapies
acronyms.description: Swedish registry/web-system for evidence-based care in heart disease.

acronyms.expansion: TicAgrelor Versus CLOpidogrel in Stabilized Patients With Acute Myocardial Infarction
acronyms.description: Trial comparing ticagrelor and clopidogrel in stabilized AMI patients.
Refers to use of three antithrombotic agents.

acronyms.expansion: Ticagrelor Monotherapy After 3 Months in the Patients Treated With New Generation Sirolimus Stent for Acute Coronary Syndrome
acronyms.description: Study of ticagrelor monotherapy following short DAPT in ACS patients with new generation sirolimus stents.
Well-known research group/score and trials related to thrombolysis and myocardial infarction.
Clinical endpoint referring to repeat revascularization of the treated lesion.

acronyms.expansion: Immediate Unselected Coronary Angiography Versus Delayed Triage in Survivors of Out-of-hospital Cardiac Arrest Without ST-segment Elevation
acronyms.description: Trial comparing immediate vs delayed coronary angiography in OHCA survivors without ST-elevation.
